primary.title: Can Nifty 50 hit 30,000 by FY27-end? Smallcase managers remain bullish despite 9% decline YTD
primary.summary: Despite a 9% decline in Nifty this year, smallcase managers are optimistic about FY27, predicting the index will reach 28,000–30,000. They emphasize earnings growth over valuation expansion, highlighting sectors like Banking and Capital Goods for future gains.
